title: Kissed Herbal Italian King Prawns Ragu
description: A festive Italian dish featuring king prawns in a herbal ragu, served in a ti-leaf wrap. This vegan-friendly dish is made with a deglaze-fond and has a glassy-jelly texture.

ingredients.name: mixed herbs
ingredients.notes: such as basil, oregano, and thyme

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the mixed herbs and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the vegetable broth and bring to a simmer.
Add the king prawns and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice and agave nectar.
Season the ragu with salt and pepper to taste.
Wrap each portion of the ragu in a ti leaf and serve immediately.
